_comment: THE LIVE CAPTURE, VERBATIM. This is the `getInfinityStatus` response the real
Carrier cloud returned to `energycap discover` on 2026-08-17T13:13:04.777Z, copied
field for field from the gitignored `data/discover-raw.json` with NOTHING trimmed:
all eight reported zones, every key our query asks for, every value exactly as the
API spelled it (numbers as strings, `null` where the field was null).
REDACTION: the system serial appears only in the GraphQL request *variables*, never
in this envelope, so it is recorded below as "<CARRIER_SERIAL>". Every zone `name`
arrived as JSON null, so no room labels are present. What remains that could be
called personal is one morning of indoor temperature and humidity.
WHY IT IS COMMITTED SEPARATELY FROM status_varcap.json: that fixture is this capture
trimmed to two zones for readable per-field assertions. This one is the ground truth
the trim is answerable to - tests/test_bryant_live_capture.py replays it whole and
pins the exact row set, which is the only evidence that the shipped code does the
right thing with what the hardware actually sends.
What it settles (PLAN.md 7.3's open question, DEVIATIONS.md #59 and #75.1):
* `odu.type` = "gs3ngiphp" - Greenspeed, i.e. a VARIABLE-CAPACITY compressor;
* `odu.opstat` = "35" - a 0-100 capacity percentage, not a word STAGE_CODES knows,
so this payload emits `stage_pct` = 35.0 (unit pct, channel `system`) and NEVER
a `stage` row, on this system, forever;
* `idu.opstat` = "off" - a word, in the same payload: proof that STAGE_SOURCE=odu
is what decides which unit is read, and that a fallback would silently archive a
different physical unit's state;
* `cfgem` = "F" - the temperature-unit question (#75.10) is closed for this house;
* `isDisconnected` = false and the operation was `getInfinityStatus`, so the
per-serial query resolves and the #64 fallback is not needed (#75.2);
* eight zones are reported and exactly one (`zone_1`) is `enabled: "on"` (#75.6).
The seven phantoms carry a plausible rh/htsp/clsp and a null rt: filtering on
nullness instead of `enabled` would fabricate seven zones' worth of rows a cycle.
